tagline: Agentic browsers, browser automation frameworks for agents, hosted browser infrastructure and the protocols that connect them.
scope: It is about AI agents that drive a web browser, not a general scraper or test tool with no agent story.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: an agent cube with an eye-like lens, linked by a pulsing beam, moves a cursor across an upright browser window, clicking tabs and buttons as the page slides to each new layout.
